recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Removing QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.item would be a substantive model change requiring a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-10481 asked to eliminate QuestionnaireResponse.item.answer.item and use only one recursion point. The published resolution rejected that simplification because child items sometimes belong under each answer to a repeating question, while groups have no answers, and called for an invariant preventing item and answer from both appearing.
initial_application: Git 9f82d098055987a7913dff68e7a1dcd0ae199932 applied the historical source change by adding the QuestionnaireResponse.item invariant expression (answer.exists() and item.exists()).not(). The current XML StructureDefinition still contains qrs-1 with the same expression.
additional_context: Later final issues FHIR-12071, FHIR-20768, FHIR-31357, and FHIR-38853 all clarified the retained two-recursion-point design. The origin Zulip thread and a later 2024 Questionnaire stream thread both support the same repeated-answer rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the required invariant and explanatory guidance are already present in current source.
